My mom is 63 — and this is one of the ways she eats her skincare 🥕 She calls it her glow juice — the one she makes almost every morning. You only need 5 things 👇 1. 🌊 Cevitol Marine Collagen Peptides 300 Dalton marine collagen peptides — 100% pure collagen made specifically for skin, recommended by dermatologists and pharmacists. 2. 🥕 Carrots Rich in beta-carotene, which supports skin cell renewal and keeps skin looking firm. 3. 🫚 Ginger Contains anti-inflammatory compounds that help manage oxidative stress inside the skin — one of the biggest causes of skin aging. 4. 🍊 Fresh oranges Loaded with vitamin C that brightens your skin. 5. 🍋 Lemon Helps clear impurities from within your skin, leaving it looking clear and radiant. ✅ How to make it: Chop the carrots, oranges, lemon, and a small piece of ginger, and add them all to the blender. Add one scoop of Cevitol marine collagen and blend until smooth. Strain it through a fine sieve, then pour into a tall glass. One glass a day — that's all she does. ✅ Why it works Carrots support skin cell renewal and help keep your skin looking firm. Ginger contains anti-inflammatory compounds that help manage oxidative stress.  Fresh oranges and lemon are packed with vitamin C, which helps your skin look brighter and clearer. But the real magic?  The marine collagen. Cevitol uses ultra-fine 300 Dalton marine collagen peptides, designed for easy absorption.  When you nourish your skin from the inside out, it can show on your face. Always remember — true beauty starts in the kitchen 🍽️✨ #antiaging #eatingskincare #skinjuice

videos.caption: Rutina de skincare masculina: simple, rápida y sin complicarte. 👀 1️⃣ Limpieza 🧼 Mójate la cara con agua tibia, aplica una pequeña cantidad de limpiador en tus manos y masajea suavemente el rostro. Enjuaga bien y sécate con una toalla limpia, dando toques en lugar de frotar. 2️⃣ Hidratante ligero 💧 Después de limpiar, aplica una hidratante tipo gel oil-free, como Neutrogena Hydro Boost. Ayuda a mantener la piel hidratada sin dejar una sensación pesada. 3️⃣ Protector solar ☀️ El paso que no deberías saltarte. Un protector como Eucerin ayuda a proteger tu piel de la radiación UV y puede ser una buena opción si buscas una textura ligera. Esta es una rutina básica que puede funcionar para muchas personas con piel grasa, pero cada piel es diferente. Si tienes dudas sobre qué productos necesitas, consulta con un dermatólogo. HOW to repair you skin barrier and not make it even worse if you have OILY SKIN? 👇🏻 your skincare routine while healing your barrier:  ☀️: gentle cleanser + hydrating serum + barrier moisturizer + spf 🌙: micellar water/ oil or milk cleanser + cleanser + hydrating serum + barrier moisturizer  and please, STOP drying out your skin to make it less oily, instead do this:  1. if you’re extremely oily in the morning, use gentle cleanser. which one? look for something with rice, hyaluronic acid or ceramides  2. NEVER skip moisturizer! this is a MUST and you need moisturizer that will support your oily skin (and no, aestura’s cream won’t help you, it is for dry skin girlies, and you need something gel-based) look for ceramides, panthenol/B5, squalane or glycerine in your moisturizer and opt for gel-based products  3. humectants every single time you apply skincare. get yourself hyaluronic acid or beta-glucan serum and it will save your skin in a week, trust me  4. lightweight sunscreen every morning. you won’t  repair your skin barrier if you skip spf.. i’m being for real, so find yourself water-based or airy sunscreen (like beauty of joseon’s aqua fresh spf, or tocobo’s water gel sun cream) 5. zinc PCA or niacinamide. these two control oil production, so if you find skincare infused with any of these ingredients – GORGEOUS (but make sure to use low niacinamide concentrations, like 2-4% max)  6. pause actives. no retinoids will help you if your skin barrier is weak and damaged. first we heal our barrier, then we use any actives we need  subscribe, my page is all about making your oily skin look gorgeous and glowy 🤭✨ #oilyskin #skinbarrier #clearskin #skincaretips #oilyskintips

See below for products. In this series I’ll teach you my approach to skincare, we’re starting basic and building from there. I’ll give product recs, but it’s really about explaining why each step is there, not just selling you products. SUNSCREEN • EltaMD UV Clear: my go to starter sunscreen. Great formulation, contains niacinamide • Supergoop Unseen: a favorite for the guys • Colorescience Sunforgettable: tinted, great if you want a makeup effect • ISDIN Eryfotona: for when you want serious protection, all mineral CLEANSER Most people don’t need to cleanse in the morning. Water is often enough. Otherwise keep it simple (aka cheap) • Cetaphil, CeraVe Cream to Foam, or La Roche Posay Purifying Foaming Cleanser all work great • Wearing makeup? Cleanse twice or start with a cleansing balm RETINOL Over the counter is a great place to start but this is one category that I think warrants a convo with your derm to see if prescription strength tretinoin (/altreno/arazlo/etc) is right for you. Or if you have really sensitive rosacea prone skin, talk to a derm about maybe dropping the retinol For starting out: • Neutrogena Retinol Pro, Avène Retrinal, SkinBetter Alpha Ret MOISTURIZER A healthy barrier means less irritation and smoother skin • Prequel AM/PM, Dieux Instant Angel, or Vanicream Moisturizing Cream are all versatile picks that work for most skin types Next video we start the advanced routine! #skincare #dermatologist
